plate_findings.evidence: Caption: "OCT shows thinning of retinal nerve fiber layer"; this corresponds to retinal ganglion cell/optic nerve fiber loss in LHON.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Panel A is a clinical OCT image from an article specifically about Leber hereditary optic neuropathy, and the captioned retinal nerve fiber layer thinning is a characteristic manifestation consistent with optic nerve atrophy. B: Panel B is a clinical OCT image from an article specifically about Leber hereditary optic neuropathy, and the captioned retinal nerve fiber layer thinning is a characteristic manifestation consistent with optic nerve atrophy.
